item.title: Atlanta billboards call for 'justice' for Adriana Smith, mother of baby Chance
item.description: The billboards call for "Justice for Adriana," and her mother's comments imply that changing the laws in Georgia is a means to securing that justice.

item.title: Woman saved from sinking car gives birth hours later... on her birthday
item.description: “When he swung that door open, I was just like, ‘Okay, you are an angel. You came out of nowhere."

item.title: One Senate vote nixed putting pro-life amendment on Wyoming ballot
item.description: The Senate was considering a resolution that would have given the legislature the ability to impose restrictions on abortion. It failed by a single vote.

item.title: Teacher used abortion to cover up her predatory rape of male students
item.description: A New Jersey teacher has been sentenced to 10 years in prison for grooming and raping two of her students, and had at least one abortion to cover up her crimes.

item.title: California pet pharmacy owner operates second pharmacy selling abortion pills
item.description: The owner of a veterinary pharmacy in California is also the apparent owner of an online, mail-order pharmacy listed as dispensing the abortion pill.

item.title: Kentucky couple charged in baby's death after year-long investigation
item.description: A Kentucky couple was indicted in the death of an infant following a year-long investigation. Pro-abortion activists are using the arrest to argue for abortion.

item.title: Man charged with death of preborn baby after killing his brother, brother's pregnant wife
item.description: A man arrested in the deaths of his half-brother and sister-in-law is also facing a charge for killing the couple's preborn child.

item.title: Quebec sees nearly 80% increase in abortion pill use in one year
item.description: Following the relaxation of safety regulations and the push for easier access, abortion pill use is skyrocketing in Quebec.

item.title: CDC provisional data shows drop in US births in 2025
item.description: Provisional data from the Centers for Disease Control show that the US birth rate continues to drop, keeping the nation on track for economic decline.

item.title: Planned Parenthood drops effort to add abortion as Oregon constitutional right
item.description: Planned Parenthood and pro-abortion allies have withdrawn a petition to add an Oregon constitutional amendment declaring abortion a state right.
